t: ADVENT 2021: JOY
s: But the joy of the first Christmas – the do not be afraid for I bring you good news of great joy for all people is an internal reality that is independent of external life – it is found in eternal life. I believe Scripture bears this out – at least the idea that joy is something deep. So today, as we look for just a moment at advent joy, I want us to grasp the real joy of Christmas which lasts long after the tree and the lights are down, long after the wrapping paper and bows have made their way to the dump, long after the toys have lost their luster, long after the decorations have been stored in the closet.
